purpose: One canonical contract-backed inventory model; exact finite-model optimization and untouched common-random-number evaluation. This protocol is committed before executing the new experiment.

model.inventory_semantics: Perishable periodic-review stock. Unmet demand is lost, not carried. Only the exogenous regime and previous contract persist. No identification with the historical backlog simulator is made.

methods.full_contract: Exact backward induction over every stock and contract level.
methods.expanded_action_mdp: Ordinary MDP with action (stock,contract), identical primitives; must coincide exactly with full_contract.
methods.frozen_contract: Exact state-aware stock optimization; economic contract fixed at 1/2. Same full state observation and unrestricted stock table.
methods.physical_oracle: Exact state-aware minimization of theta-free physical cost; evaluated also under the fixed contract 1/2. No deliberately misspecified physical reward.
methods.capacity_matched_gate: Unrestricted stock table with a dummy latent gate and frozen economic contract. Must coincide with frozen_contract. Dummy evaluations are explicitly not distinct economic actions.

optimization.method: Exact rational backward induction; no trained network, search seed, or hyperparameter selection.
optimization.tie_break: Greatest maximizer in the product order, implemented by lexicographic (value,stock,contract) maximization.
optimization.evaluation_accounting: Record distinct actions and all candidate evaluations separately. The same 143 candidate slots can be evaluated for each state/stage; frozen methods have duplicate contract slots. Exact exhaustive optimization, not duplicate slots, removes the search-capacity confound.

evaluation.primary: Discounted net contractual reward versus frozen_contract.
evaluation.uncertainty: Exact model expectations are primary. Paired 64-batch Monte Carlo means and standard errors measure simulation error only, not external validity or training variability.
evaluation.no_selection: No configuration screening, test-seed replacement, favorable-subset reporting, or tuning against observed test signs.

additional_checks: Original penalty-only counterexample and external-premium monotonicity condition
Gibbs variational identity and action-conditioned versus full-operator distinction
Boundary-complete HJB value/policy estimates and an explicit monotone upwind scheme
Finite-state residual certificate with both value-comparison contributions
Direct-P/Z conditioning under fixed, vanishing, and data-generated noise scales
Historical inventory ledger reconstruction without changing its training protocol
interpretation: Synthetic verification of a specified model, not field validation and not a certificate for historical neural inventory runs. Negative physical comparisons will be retained.
